question: Estimate the unique reach of a sponsored event (e.g., Filmfare or IIFA) for a brand sponsor.
idealClarificationQuestions: Filmfare/IIFA awards: TV broadcast + OTT + social media + on-ground? Yes — total brand exposure.
Title sponsor or category sponsor? Major category sponsor (logo on stage, banners, mentions).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: TV broadcast (Sony/Colors typically): ~6-8 crore TV reach over a 3-hour broadcast.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Total live + recorded TV/OTT: ~8-10 crore unique.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: PR / news coverage carrying brand mentions: ~3-5 crore additional press exposure.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Branded recall (people who associate brand with event): ~15-20% = ~1.5-2 crore retained brand impressions.

benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~6-8 crore TV reach over a 3-hour broadcast.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Social media (clips, behind-the-scenes, viral red carpet content)
benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~25 crore views over 1 month, ~5 crore unique.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: PR / news coverage carrying brand mentions
Branded recall (people who associate brand with event)

calculationFlow: TV broadcast (Sony/Colors typically): ~6-8 crore TV reach over a 3-hour broadcast.
OTT live + replays: ~2-3 crore additional unique viewers.
Total live + recorded TV/OTT: ~8-10 crore unique.
Social media (clips, behind-the-scenes, viral red carpet content): ~25 crore views over 1 month, ~5 crore unique.
PR / news coverage carrying brand mentions: ~3-5 crore additional press exposure.
Total unique multi-platform reach: ~10-12 crore unique people.
Branded recall (people who associate brand with event): ~15-20% = ~1.5-2 crore retained brand impressions.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: Branded recall (people who associate brand with event): ~15-20% = ~1.5-2 crore retained brand impressions.
